name: Animated Button
description: Multi-variant interactive button with shimmering effects and micro-interactions.
summary: A call-to-action button with four visual styles (primary, secondary, outline and shimmer). Uses a cubic-bezier timing curve, scale-[0.96] compression on press, a shimmer overlay layer, and an arrow icon that shifts on hover.
highlights: Four production-ready visual variants tuned for dark-mode interfaces
Shimmer overlay layer for the shimmer variant (requires a shimmer keyframe in your global CSS to animate)
Tactile cubic-bezier timing curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for snappy feedback
Forwarded ref support with full HTML button attribute inheritance
Automatic hover translation on accessory directional icons with group-hover
anatomy: <span> (Content Shell housing label and optional icon)

physics.description: High-frequency micro-interactions utilizing CSS cubic-bezier timing curves and scale compression on click.

parameters.label: Shimmer
parameters.value: animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite] (needs a shimmer keyframe in global CSS)

accessibility.aria: Inherits native HTMLButtonElement attributes including aria-disabled, aria-label, and aria-pressed.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No reduced-motion handling. The press scale and hover icon shift always run.

keyboard.description: Focus the button (browser default focus outline).
Trigger button onClick event with active compression effect.

recommended: Primary conversion CTAs on landing page heroes and product announcements
Form submission actions in checkout, modal, and onboarding flows
Interactive navigation links requiring elevated visual priority
bestPractices: Limit the shimmer variant to 1 instance per viewport to preserve visual hierarchy
Use outline or secondary variants for auxiliary actions like Cancel or Dismiss
Always provide descriptive text children or an aria-label for icon-only usage

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant of the button: high-contrast white primary, dark secondary, bordered outline, or luminous shimmer.

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Display an animated arrow icon on hover with smooth translateX translation.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer interactions, suppresses hover transforms, and lowers opacity.

props.name: type
props.description: Native HTML button behavior for forms and dialogs.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to override dimensions, paddings, or font weights.

props.name: children
props.description: Content label, icons, or badges rendered inside the button.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click event handler callback invoked on button press.
